integrity: Exact rational finite enumeration was run successfully; proofs of infinite-size laws are analytical. Existing generic Poisson and one-dependent CLT mechanisms are attributed to prior work. Scholarly priority remains subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Independent atomless continuous score observations and independent coordinate replacement; no guarantees for adversarial edits, ties or general correlation. The total-variation bound is informative when np^2 is small; the Gaussian CLT has no quantitative rate.
title: Sparse refresh noise creates silent descent errors in uniform random rankings
